description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Summer Cottage,” a beautifully designed, family-centered home nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Perfect for making memories together, this coastal retreat features a large private courtyard with a fire feature and fountain, 4 suites, and is located just a 1-min walk from the Sky Pool and fitness center. Only a 7-minute walk to the beach, this vacation home also includes 6 bikes for exploring the charming community. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps from Sky Pool and fitness centerPrivate courtyard with a fire feature and tranquil fountain7 minute walk to the sugar-white sandsAccommodates up to 10 guests with 3 King suites and a bunk room for 4 with En-suiteFully equipped kitchen and spacious living area ideal for entertainingThree large covered porches for reading, relaxing, or sipping your favorite drink6 bikes included for exploring Rosemary Beach’s hidden paths and parksEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Great location and house, a little on the small side but the backyard made up for it." – Lindsey W.⭐"We loved our stay! Communication was easy, and the house was perfect for all ages in our family." – Courtney W.⭐"Great house, incredible location, and so walkable! Would definitely stay here again." – Deanna A.*** LIVING AREA ***Step inside "Summer Cottage" and feel immediately at home with open, light-filled spaces expertly designed for both relaxation and entertainment. Professionally decorated, the living area boasts coastal elegance, offering plenty of room for everyone to gather.Spacious living area with comfortable seating and tasteful decorLarge flat-screen TV perfect for movie nightsEasy access to the private courtyard*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The heart of the home is the open-concept kitchen and dining space, ideal for making group meals and sharing family moments.Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances and ample counter spaceDining area with seating for 6Kitchen bar seating for 4*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Unwind in the charming private courtyard, a serene outdoor space where you can relax with the sounds of trickling water by the fire.Private courtyard with a cozy fire feature and water fountainBBQ grill and shaded dining area for 6Three spacious covered porches perfect for lounging or people-watchingYour stay includes 6 bikes for touring the community*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Each spacious bedroom is a peaceful retreat, filled with natural light and styled for comfort and relaxation. Enjoy luxurious bedding, smart TVs, and private en-suite bathrooms for ultimate convenience and ease.1st Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, en-suite bathroom, flat-screen TV, and courtyard access2nd Floor:King Guest Suite 1: King bed, en-suite bath, private porchKing Guest Suite 2: King bed, en-suite bath with walk-in showerBunk Room: Two twin-over-twin bunk beds with private bathroom*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Rosemary Beach isn’t just a destination; it’s an experience. This beachside community includes award-winning architecture, secret boardwalks, and endless charm. The emerald water creates a stunning backdrop for family photos, while gorgeous sunsets set the stage for relaxing evenings. With 2.3 miles of footpaths and lush green fields perfect for family time, every moment here becomes unforgettable.Sky Pool – 1-minute walkRosemary Beach – 7-minute walkFitness Center & Racquet Club – Steps awayLocal Shops & Dining at Barrett Square – 4-minute walkRosemary Beach Community: Beachside Destination with Award-Winning ArchitectureMultiple Parks & Greens: Playgrounds, Splash Pad, Butterfly Park, Boardwalks, and Fountains4 RESORT POOLS:Barbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There is an active camera on the carriage house over the courtyard that overlooks the carriage house door.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 27268STRO #: STR-027268
